title: Office Impact Summit
summary: A full day for office, workplace and facilities professionals: keynotes, roundtables, wellbeing moments and peer connection.
body: The first Office Impact Summit was created for the people who run the workplace and shape how it feels. The programme combined practical roundtables, keynote sessions and time to connect with peers.

title: Q1 Community Coffee Meetup
summary:
